evidence: Adds --enable-multiprocess support, Cap'n Proto interface definitions, libmultiprocess subtree updates, and subprocess spawning for bitcoin-node, bitcoin-wallet, and bitcoin-gui.
rationale: Implements the foundational architecture for process separation, isolating node, wallet, and GUI components into distinct executables over Cap'n Proto IPC. Merging this PR establishes the core privilege boundaries of project #28722 and unblocks dependent multiprocess PRs such as #19460 and #19461.
